notes: Learner-style film requests, one concept per length preset (PRD 28, FV-11). Several phrasings per concept keep trials from all sharing one wording. The bench runs the same prompts for tokens and dollars per length; the film evals run them for pass rates with a zero-broken gate.

phrasings: Show me a 30-second film about how a pendulum keeps time.
Make a short film: why does a pendulum swing in the same time whatever its size?
A half-minute film on pendulums keeping time, please.
Show me a one-minute film about what a wave carries.
Make a 60-second film: a wave carries energy while the water only bobs.
I want a minute-long film explaining wave energy.

concepts.concept: how a support team handles a ticket
phrasings: Show me a two-minute film about how a support team handles a ticket.
Make a film, about two minutes, on a ticket arriving, being triaged and resolved.
How does a ticket move through a support team? A 2-minute film, please.

concepts.concept: how a leaf turns light into food
phrasings: Show me a three-minute film about how a leaf turns light into food.
Make a 3-minute film: sunlight, water and air becoming sugar in a leaf.
Photosynthesis as a three-minute film for a biology student.

concepts.concept: how water reaches a city tap
phrasings: Show me a four-minute film about how water reaches a city tap.
Make a 4-minute film: from reservoir through treatment to the tap.
A four-minute film on the journey of tap water, please.
